Single computer models are often not enough to describe
some phenomena. Examples are the flow inside your
pulsating heart, the ice-sheet melting in the arctic, or a
material with tangible behavior defined by phenomena at
the smallest scales. The software library preCICE allows
programmers and end users to combine existing models
with minimal effort, producing accurate results and
running on a laptop or a supercomputer. Recent
improvements have made the software easier to use,
faster, more accurate, and fitting for new types of
coupling. We now need to guide the rapidly growing
community with producing and sharing quality
contributions, and to provide tools to make building
